name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Hand-Carved Tri-Tip Steak Sandwich on Garlic Roll
whyItWorks: Thinly carved Santa Maria style grilled tri-tip steak on a soft toasted roll with mild barbecue sauce. Rich in bioavailable iron and protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Tri-Tip Sandwich with light BBQ sauce; request roll toasted with light butter (hold raw onions).
